title_en: Famous Restaurants (16/20): A Hong Kong Roast Goose Restaurant
note_en: 一旦 A，就 B means "once A happens, B follows immediately": 一旦咬开脆皮，油香就立刻在嘴里散开 "the moment you bite through the crisp skin, the aroma fills your mouth." Notice that 就 goes after the subject of the second clause (油香就), not at the start of it, while English puts "then" or nothing at all there; 一旦 can also describe something that has not happened yet, like English "if ever."
